openings.claim: Current metadata may misselect weekly membership; renames may impair recognition.
openings.probe: Compare current/week-effective selection against agreed fabricated rosters: reassignment, rename, unchanged and split cases across two centers; inspect labels separately.
openings.uncertainty: History availability, repair cost, fixture realism and production causality unknown.

openings.claim: Direct replacements may reduce dispatch/delivery delay; handling benefit depends on active follow-up burden.
openings.discriminator: Request-to-file latency versus active workload; execution time separately.
openings.probe: Six coordinators, two sessions each: time checking, correction, download, import and follow-up; reconcile timestamps. Verify explicit center/week and off-schedule reuse; compare queued/direct fabricated runs, concurrent attendance and isolation including splits; estimate cost.
openings.uncertainty: Sessions miss multi-day follow-up; waiting is not work. Authorization/concurrency feasibility unknown; unchanged faulty requests stay faulty.

openings.claim: Existing timetables may supply intended courses before export.
openings.discriminator: Accuracy and total handling including transcription.
openings.probe: Verify ownership, freshness and identifiers; compare current checking/private pre-export confirmation on equivalent reassigned, renamed and split weeks.
openings.uncertainty: Heterogeneous/stale timetables, ambiguous mappings and implementation cost may defeat benefit.

decision: Diagnose before choosing. Shared ceiling: six engineer-days/existing hosting. Preserve private authorized data, CSV schema and uninterrupted attendance. Synthetic observations establish no cause; clean samples/completion logs prove neither isolation nor correctness. Next 40: median handling <=12 minutes, >=38 intended sets, zero foreign-center records.
